import re def get_html_tags(html_input: str): """ Extracts all HTML tags from the provided string. Parameters ---------- html_input : str A string containing HTML content. Returns ------- list[str] A list of tag strings (including the angle brackets), e.g. ['
', '

', '']. Notes ----- - The function uses a non-greedy regular expression to match tags. - It is designed to be robust against malformed input and will never raise an exception; in case of any error it returns an empty list. """ try: # Regex matches anything that starts with '<', ends with '>', # and does not contain a stray '>' inside the tag. pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+?>') return pattern.findall(html_input) except Exception: # Defensive: any unexpected error results in an empty list. return []
